statBlock.name: Adult Brass Dragon
statBlock.description: Brass dragons favor desert lairs and seek out travelers for conversation.

sections.Traits: Legendary Resistance (3/day). The dragon can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. The dragon may first use Frightful Presence. It makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Frightful Presence. Choose creatures within 120 ft. that are aware of the dragon. Each makes a DC 16 Wisdom save or is Frightened for 1 minute. A creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A successful initial or repeat save, or the end of the effect, grants immunity to this dragon’s Frightful Presence for 24 hours.
Breath Weapons (recharge 5–6). Choose one of the following options. Both use the same recharge.
Fire Breath. Creatures in a 60-ft. line, 5 ft. wide, make a DC 18 Dexterity save. Failure deals 45 (13d6) fire damage. Success halves it.
Sleep Breath. Creatures in a 60-ft. cone make a DC 18 Constitution save or fall Unconscious for 10 minutes. Damage or someone using an action to wake the creature ends the effect early.
sections.Legendary actions:
The dragon has 3 legendary actions. It can use one option at the end of another creature’s turn and refreshes its budget at the start of its own turn. It can’t use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or while surprised until it finishes its first turn.
Detect (1 action). Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make a Tail attack.
Wing Attack (2 actions). Creatures within 10 ft. make a DC 19 Dexterity save. On a failure a creature takes 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and falls Prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.
sections.Lair actions:
In its lair, the dragon can choose one option on initiative count 20, losing ties. It can’t use a lair action while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or while surprised until it finishes its first turn.
Wind. Creatures within 60 ft. of the dragon make a DC 15 Strength save. A failure pushes the creature 15 ft. away and knocks it Prone. The wind disperses gases and vapors and puts out unprotected flames. Each protected flame has a 50 percent chance to go out.
Sand Cloud. Choose a point the dragon can see within 120 ft. A cloud spreads around corners in a 20-ft.-radius sphere. Creatures in it make a DC 15 Constitution save or are Blinded for 1 minute. An affected creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Regional effects:
Choose one or more of these effects around the lair.
Within 6 miles of the lair, tracks in the sand guide travelers to shelter and hidden water and divert them from places the dragon wants left alone. Harmless, moving illusions of Large or smaller monsters appear within 1 mile. Physical contact reveals them, or a distant observer can spot one with a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check. If a creature with Intelligence 3 or higher comes within 30 ft. of a water source within 1 mile, the dragon learns its presence and location. After the dragon dies, the tracks fade over 1d10 days and the other effects end immediately.
sections.Variant spellcasting: Under the optional dragon spellcasting rule, the DM chooses 3 spells of 4th level or lower. The dragon can cast each once per day without material components. It uses Charisma, with spell save DC 16 and +8 to hit with spell attacks.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 86 and 105–106. Official errata corrects Fire Breath’s average damage.
